moisture.source: Fastmarkets iron ore methodology (January 2026): moisture base 8% for 62%/61% Fe fines fot Qingdao

port_charges_rmb_wmt.source: Implied by Ruida Futures import-cost estimates (30 to 35) and Fastmarkets port-to-seaborne conversions (28 to 35); Mysteel uses 23, Huatai Futures 35

financing_spread_bp.unit: basis points over the USD reference rate
financing_spread_bp.source: Assumed trade finance spread over SOFR (effective fed funds before April 2018); sensitivity 50 to 300 bp

financing_extra_days.unit: days added to the laden voyage
financing_extra_days.source: Assumed time for discharge, customs clearance and payment after arrival

cm_target_days.source: Cargo priced today arrives in roughly 2 to 6 weeks

cm_min_oi_lots.source: One Capesize cargo (170,000 t) of open interest

cm_min_days.source: Exclude contracts in their final days

cm_max_extrapolation_days.source: Linear extrapolation before the first eligible expiry is allowed up to this distance

band_rmb_dmt.source: DCE delivery fee 0.5 + storage 0.3/day x 30 days + ship outbound fee cap 12 = 21.5 RMB/t (27.5 at the pre-2021 storage fee of 0.5/day)

mill_other_costs_rebar.source: Constant implied by Everbright Futures' 2026 daily rebar margins; published range 950 to 1,250

insurance_rate.source: CFR approximates the customs value; China Customs deems insurance at 0.3% of goods plus freight when unknown
